s: a male given name from Old High German, equivalent to English Alvin.
Alwin.et: From Old High German Adalwin, from Proto-West Germanic *Aþalawini, equivalent to Old High German adal (“noble”) + Old High German wini (“friend”), cognate with English Alwin, English Alvin, and Dutch Adelwijn.
